podcast.body: This was the band's first album, released in 2004, and it featured three singles, including "Feel It," which was co-written by Trent Reznor. "The biggest thing Jackalope ever did was the first album, which was released in 2004. It featured three singles, the first of which was co-written by Trent Resner. ... from their debut album, which was called It Dreams."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
